description:
About the Position

This PhD project, supervised by Dr Julianna Panidi (School of Engineering), focuses on developing eco-friendly and high-performing organic photovoltaics (OPVs) using sustainable materials and manufacturing methods.

Research Focus

  • Eliminate Toxic Materials: Replace toxic solvents with eco-friendly alternatives
  • Enhance Performance: Improve efficiency of organic photovoltaics
  • Improve Stability: Increase lifetime of OPV devices
  • Sustainable Manufacturing: Develop green manufacturing processes
  • Characterization: Use optoelectronic and morphological analysis tools

Funding & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Potential coverage for UK students for 3.5-4 years
  • Stipend: Competitive funding may be available for 3.5-4 years
  • Research Costs: Access to cleanroom and characterization facilities
  • Training: Comprehensive training in device fabrication and analysis

Eligibility and Requirements

  • 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent)
  • Background in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or Materials Science
  • English Language: Meet University's English language requirements
  • Strongly recommended to contact supervisor before applying

Application Process

  1. Contact supervisor
  2. Discuss research interests
  3. Submit application through Degree Finder
  4. Provide academic documents
  5. Funding competition
  6. Award notification

About the University of Edinburgh

University of Edinburgh is a public research university in Scotland's capital and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across medicine, science, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its research community supports collaboration across disciplines, connecting academic inquiry with challenges affecting health, technology and society.

Official website: https://www.ed.ac.uk/

Important Notes

  • Competitive funding available.
  • Sustainability focus: develop truly green energy technologies.
  • Interdisciplinary research combining chemistry, physics, and engineering.
  • Address critical barrier to commercialization.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 December 2026 (closing time not specified). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
